description: Knox Plaud ingest was not spawned during boot. Step-01 explicitly marks this NON-SKIPPABLE with no valid excuse other than Agent tool unavailability. Agent tool was available. This is a protocol violation.
correction: Spawn Knox for Plaud ingest immediately after boot identity load. No exceptions.
proposed_fix: Add pre-delivery gate check: before presenting boot briefing, verify knox_spawn is in outputs. If missing, spawn Knox before proceeding.
